name: 30756-imageprefill-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03; sealed by configs/env.yaml.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- an 8B bf16 checkpoint is ~17 GB on an 80 GB card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup 20%, bound 240 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn image+text: one 2048x2048 JPEG per request (guidellm synthetic_image, jpeg q85, content gradient, seed 42) with a 32-token question and 32 output tokens, both pinned min=max; images are row-seeded, so no two requests carry the same pixels.
purpose: A visual question-answering service handling single high-resolution photos with short questions, four concurrent users, one GPU.
launch:
# Engine command line for commit e80455ca8b696452b98d91785175210ed7a1bd41
# (v0.13.0rc1-203-ge80455ca8b69). The interpreter and the hardware seal are in env.yaml.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 8192
max-num-seqs: 8

# Must match scenario.json's `images_per_request`: it is both the admission limit and what the
# engine's startup profiling pass is sized against. Change one and you must change both.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0
